I’ve restarted my phone as you suggested. What should I do next? My phone is currently in Airplane Mode—should I turn that off to test the internet speed?

My SIM card status is “Active” and the APN name is set to “internet” with the MMSC URL as http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc. What should I try next to get my internet working at excellent speed?

I restarted my phone as you suggested, but when I tried to run the speed test again, it still failed and says “No Connection.” I still don’t have internet access, even though the status bar shows excellent signal and 5G. What else can we try?
